item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena visits a forest near her village with her school class. Her teacher asks why the forest is a home for many life forms, and not just a group of trees.

Which reason is correct?

options.A: The forest has dense and varied plant growth that gives many animals, birds and insects food and shelter.
options.B: The forest has many tall trees, so it must be a home for many life forms.
options.C: The forest looks green from far away, so many life forms can live there.
options.D: The forest is a home only for large wild animals that need space to move.
